Proposition
[Decomposition into hyperbolic and collapsed pieces] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0239, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0254, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0255, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0256, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0257, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0258 ↗ prop:chow-iv-stability-hyperbolic-limits ↗ lem:chow-iv-almost-hyperbolic-pieces-disjoint 1. ch33:33.8\group Stability of hyperbolic limits

There is a finite family of complete finite-volume hyperbolic manifolds $(\mathcal H_\alpha ,h_\alpha )$ such that, for every sufficiently small $\varepsilon >0$, sufficiently late time slices contain pairwise disjoint harmonically parametrized truncations of these manifolds, $\varepsilon $-close in $C^{[1/\varepsilon ]}$ and satisfying the CMC boundary conditions, while the complement has injectivity radius everywhere less than $\varepsilon $.
